At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

As Head of Managed Services, you own the delivery, performance, and growth of our Hedge Accounting managed services practice, spanning FX and Interest Rate Risk management. You lead a team of Derivative Accountants and Managers, and you’re accountable for the practice end to end: client satisfaction, delivery quality, staffing, and the workflows that let the team execute with consistent quality and client satisfaction. 

Beyond running today’s practice, you’ll shape where it goes next: bringing AI and automation into how the team delivers, partnering with Product Management on what clients need now and next, and expanding the value clients realize across Ripple’s broader platform.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Practice Management & Operations

  • Own the day-to-day operating model, from trade capture through close, disclosure, and audit response, across FX and Interest Rate programs.
  • Lead Hedge Accounting Managers and Derivative Accountants; own hiring, org design, and workforce planning.
  • Drive resource planning and capacity forecasting; set and hold the team accountable to delivery KPIs.
  • Identify and introduce AI and automation that make the team faster and more scalable; own the practice’s AI roadmap.
  • Set the practice’s technical standards and methodology for FX and Interest Rate hedge programs; serve as final escalation for issues the SME can’t resolve.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Set performance expectations, coach, and give feedback that builds both technical depth and delivery discipline.
  • Develop each Manager’s technical and people leadership so routine decisions get made without you.
  • Build the team’s fluency with AI-enabled tools and new ways of working.

Technical Expertise & Escalation

  • Serve as a practice technical expert on ASC 815 and IFRS 9 hedge accounting across FX and Interest Rate risk.
  • Act as escalation point for novel, contested, or high-risk questions and step into audit conversations personally, when required.
  • Track FASB/IASB developments and keep the practice ahead of upcoming changes.

Product Collaboration & Portfolio Expansion

  • Partner with Product Management, translating what you see across the practice into clear guidance on current and future client needs.
  • Represent the client’s evolving needs in product planning.
  • Identify and lead expansion opportunities that help clients realize value across Ripple’s broader portfolio, beyond hedge accounting managed services.

Client & Cross-Functional

  • Serve as senior escalation point for the most complex client, audit, and accounting matters.
  • Build strategic relationships with client treasury, accounting, and finance leadership.
  • Partner with Product, Implementation, and Customer Success on platform capabilities and service design; with Sales and Renewals on growth and retention.
  • Represent Managed Services in internal reporting on portfolio health and performance.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • CPA and/or advanced degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • 15+ years progressive accounting experience, 10-12+ years in derivative instruments and hedge accounting under ASC 815/IFRS 9, spanning FX and Interest Rate risk.
  • 7+ years managing accounting/finance teams, including managing managers.
  • Proven operational leadership of a service practice: staffing, capacity planning, KPIs, workflow design.
  • Deep, current fluency in ASC 815/IFRS 9 — able to independently defend complex, contested positions.
  • Strong grasp of FX instruments (forwards, options, cross-currency swaps) and interest rate instruments (swaps, caps, floors, collars).
  • A point of view on where AI genuinely changes service delivery, and experience evaluating and/or deploying it in an operations/accounting context.
  • Experience shaping a product roadmap in partnership with Product or Engineering, ideally in a software/platform business.
  • Track record of driving account expansion, not just protecting what’s already sold.
  • Hedge accounting platform experience (Ripple Treasury, Chatham, Reval, FIS Quantum, or comparable TMS) strongly preferred.
  • A strong communicator, able to make complex conclusions accessible, holds ground with auditors and skeptical clients.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

We're building a team of standout sales leaders, the kind who raise the performance of everyone around them.

As a Sales Manager, you'll lead a team of Account Executives and own one of our most critical growth levers: developing talent that consistently outperforms. This role is about building a high-performance sales organisation where every hire raises the bar, every coaching conversation sharpens execution, and every decision is grounded in data. You'll bring the rigour, along with energy! 

You'll be expected to coach in the work, not after it. You'll diagnose pipeline health before it becomes a forecasting problem, develop future leaders before promotions become necessary, and create an operating rhythm that enables predictable, repeatable growth.

You'll partner cross-functionally to improve how we sell, challenge the status quo, and continuously raise the talent bar across the organisation. Success is measured not only by quota attainment, but by the strength of your team, the quality of your pipeline, and the leaders you develop.

Build a High-Performance Team

  • Hire Account Executives who can run complex, multi-stakeholder deals, and raise the bar with every addition to your team.
  • Develop a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous learning and high standards.
  • Identify future top performers early and create development plans that accelerate their growth.

Co-Sell on Complex Deals

  • Sell alongside your team in discovery, business case development and negotiation on your most important pursuits.
  • Engage senior stakeholders directly, including owners, operations and finance, and help your team multi-thread rather than sell to a single champion.
  • Bring commercial judgment to pricing, deal structure and competitive displacement.
  • Advance the deal while leaving the AE more capable of running the next one without you.

Coach Through Data & Business Intelligence

  • Lead your business through rigorous pipeline inspection, forecasting and performance diagnostics.
  • Use leading indicators to identify performance gaps early and coach reps toward sustainable improvement.
  • Turn data into action by identifying trends, diagnosing root causes and driving measurable improvements across your team.
  • Forecast accurately on long-cycle deals, which depends on stage integrity rather than optimism.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Establish predictable operating rhythms around forecasting, pipeline management and business reviews.
  • Build disciplined execution that creates consistent, repeatable revenue outcomes.
  • Continuously improve how your team sells by refining processes, simplifying execution and eliminating friction.
  • Build repeatable plays for how this segment is won, from implementation and expansion.

Lead Through Influence

  • Partner closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Enablement, Operations, Partnerships and Product to improve the customer journey and strengthen commercial execution.
  • Use customer insights and field intelligence to shape strategy and influence product evolution.
  • Lead through change by helping your team adapt quickly while maintaining high performance.

You Have

  • 6+ years experience as a sales manager, including time leading teams selling into complex, multi-stakeholder accounts with cycles measured in months
  • Experience hiring, ramping and retaining Account Executives who can run considered, competitive deals
  • Experience developing already strong performers into people who win larger and more complex deals
  • Proven track record in collaborating across different teams with the ability to inspire change
  • Leadership and coaching experience and a desire to help others be their best
  • Expertise in creating structure around sales metrics and managing yourself and others to achieve these metrics, including forecast accuracy on long-cycle deals
  • An understanding of how to refine decision-making and consider the downstream and upstream effects of potential decisions

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Sales Account Director will join a team driving TRM’s go-to-market strategy in the US Private Sector market. This is a high-paced role, with a large volume of accounts that move quickly. The Account Director’s goal will be to expand and strengthen our foothold in the North American banking and large financial institutions space. We're looking for a customer-obsessed, consultative salesperson to own the entire sales process with new and existing customers. This person will be knowledgeable about blockchain intelligence and digital assets, and feel comfortable navigating complex processes to close six and seven-figure deals.

The impact you will have:

  • Connect with current and net new key stakeholders within your territory and identify what matters to them, what are their potential mission applications, who holds budgets, who makes decisions, who influences decisions, who owns which process

  • Spearhead the implementation of blockchain intelligence into customer workflows, driving towards intimate understanding of the customers' application of TRMs tooling and data to proactively find ways to improve the customers success.

  • Own, plan, execute, and/or quarterback activities to nurture client relationships, feedback loops, referrals, renewals, upsells, cross-sells, expansions

  • Create and execute strategic plans for your territory to not only ensure company goals are met across key revenue and churn metrics, but also new growth opportunities are discovered and pursued

  • Hone TRM product and customer vertical subject matter expertise to enrich every stage of the sales process from demonstrations to trial to customer advisory sessions to innovation workshops

  • Proactively gather and prioritize customer feedback and champion it within TRM

  • Develop a roster of happy customers that will refer new prospects, champion TRM, and provide crucial feedback

What we’re looking for:

  • At least 8+ years of experience selling SaaS products, or 4 years experience accompanied with expert customer domain and mission knowledge and a background in consulting

  • Experience with virtual currencies, applications, and their use in financial networks

  • Strong knowledge of crypto-native organizations as well as their workflows, procurement processes, and organizational structures

  • Strong customer-facing presentation/listening skills with the ability to establish credibility with senior executives

  • Familiarity with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulatory framework

  • A knack for storytelling. You have the ability understand customer needs and build + convey compelling value propositions

  • Ability to operate a large volume of accounts that develop quickly

  • You find excitement or fulfillment through developing meaningful client relationships, identifying new use cases, obsessing over customer happiness, meeting new contacts within accounts, and closing deals

  • Adaptable. Goals can change fast. You anticipate and react quickly

  • Autonomous. You own what you work on. You move fast and get things done

  • Excellent communication. You will need to communicate complex ideas effectively

  • Collaborative. You must work collaboratively in a cross-functional team and with people at all levels in an organization

About the Team:

  • Our team thrives on collaboration, always looking out for each other by sharing opportunities and competitive insights. We actively exchange ideas and strategies to boost each other's sales efforts. Communication is key, and we primarily use Slack, making sure to @mention colleagues for timely responses. Our routine includes weekly 1-on-1 meetings with managers, bi-weekly team meetings, and monthly Pod meetings with the broader support organization. Above all, we prioritize our customers' missions, and this dedication is reflected in every aspect of our TRM life.

  • Our team predominantly operates in the EST timezone, with some members in PST. We start our day around 8:00 am and typically finish after 5:00 pm. While we may work beyond standard hours when necessary, we deeply respect family time and strive not to intrude on it. We're committed to contributing whenever needed, ensuring our team's success isn't confined to a 40-hour workweek.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Rapid Opportunity Assessment: You'll swiftly qualify or disqualify opportunities to ensure a strong, future-focused pipeline. Your goal is to add more than $500k in qualified pipeline each month, targeting next quarter and beyond.

  • Sales Campaigns: You'll develop two new sales campaigns each month to accelerate pipeline growth, with a focus on generating in-quarter opportunities.

  • Strategic Sales Planning: You'll regularly update and evaluate a strategic sales plan for all Tier 1 current customers and identify potential Tier 1 prospects on a monthly basis.

 

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Digital Assets Accounting & Financial Reporting

About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

You’ll work closely with the security team: they set policy and lead on incidents, and you put that policy in place across our tools and devices. The scope is broad and the work is hands-on. Experience

  • Hands-on admin experience with an enterprise identity provider, an MDM and endpoint security tools.

  • Strong macOS management: configuration profiles, privacy preference and system extension policies.

  • Writes Python or Bash to automate work. Infrastructure as code is a plus.

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

DeFi Quant Research Intern - Digital Assets Market Making

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

 

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

 

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

About the Internship Program

Our internship programme gives early-career talent the opportunity to build practical skills, contribute to meaningful projects and learn alongside experienced colleagues in digital finance.

Typically lasting six months and based in our Brussels office (London possible), each internship includes hands-on experience, clear learning goals and dedicated guidance and regular feedback. We look for curiosity, relevant foundational skills, deep, active interest and passion for digital assets and the potential to grow exponentially with us - you don’t need to arrive with all the answers. Where performance, business needs and available opportunities align, an internship may lead to a permanent role, though this is not guaranteed.

We are looking for 3-4 high-caliber Quantitative Analyst Interns to sit within our Strategic Market Making (CeFi and DeFi), Credit and Corporate Development desks/teams (see other openings on our career page for details).

Application deadline: 30 November 2026
Start date: 1 March 2027

Selection process:

  • Interview with Talent Acquisition representative

  • Interview with Hiring Manager

  • Recruitment Challenge


The role

About Strategic Market Making Desk
Our Strategic Proprietary Market Making team researches and deploys systematic trading strategies across digital asset markets. Within the DeFi track, we focus on how blockchain mechanics, protocol design and on-chain market structure shape liquidity, execution and risk.

As a DeFi Quant Research Intern, you will work alongside quantitative researchers, traders and engineers to study on-chain markets and support the development of data-driven trading strategies. You will analyse blockchain and market data, test hypotheses through backtesting and simulation, build research tooling, and investigate how real-world execution—including gas, transaction ordering, liquidity fragmentation and MEV—affects strategy performance.

 

This is a technical and applied internship. We are looking for someone who combines strong quantitative reasoning and coding skills with genuine hands-on DeFi experience. You should be curious about how protocols work beneath the interface and able to connect blockchain mechanics to market behaviour and trading outcomes.



Key Responsibilities - DeFi Quant Research Intern

  • Research on-chain market structure by analysing liquidity, price formation, participant behaviour and execution across decentralized markets.

  • Study how protocol mechanics, transaction ordering, gas, slippage, latency and MEV affect execution quality and strategy performance.

  • Formulate trading hypotheses and evaluate them using blockchain data, market data, backtests and simulations.

  • Build reusable Python tools and data pipelines for research, monitoring and performance analysis.

  • Analyse relationships between centralized and decentralized markets and identify their implications for pricing, hedging and risk.

  • Support live strategies through monitoring, post-trade analysis and investigation of unexpected performance.

  • Present findings clearly, including assumptions, limitations, risks and recommended next steps.

Who You Are/Key Requirements - DeFi Quant Research Intern

  • Quantitative and coding foundations: You are pursuing or recently completed a degree in mathematics, computer science, engineering, physics, quantitative finance or a related field. You are proficient in Python for data analysis and comfortable with SQL, Git and command-line workflows.

  • Practical blockchain understanding: You understand transactions, state changes, gas, blocks, consensus and finality at a working level, and can reason about how smart-contract interactions execute on-chain.

  • DeFi market knowledge: You understand AMMs, concentrated liquidity, swaps, liquidity provision, oracles and liquidations, and how decentralized execution differs from a centralized order book.

  • MEV awareness: You understand how transaction ordering and block construction can create arbitrage, liquidation, backrunning and sandwiching opportunities or risks, and how these dynamics affect execution.

  • Hands-on curiosity: You have used DeFi beyond coursework or social media. Ideally, you have built or analysed something yourself—such as an on-chain dataset, trading or monitoring script, AMM simulation, protocol integration or research project.

  • Trading judgement: You naturally question whether an apparent edge survives fees, gas, latency, slippage, adverse selection and changing market conditions.

  • Ownership and communication: You can structure an ambiguous problem, test assumptions and communicate findings and limitations clearly in English.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience querying blockchain data through RPCs, indexers, subgraphs or analytics platforms.

  • Ability to read Solidity, contract interfaces and event logs.

  • Exposure to Rust or another systems programming language.

  • Familiarity with non-EVM ecosystems or Layer 2 execution models.

  • A technical project demonstrating sustained interest in DeFi or on-chain markets.

Our offer

  • A 6 month paid internship at world-renowned digital assets company with accommodation provided for entirety or part of it

  • The opportunity to learn about digital assets and blockchain from a 30,000 ft view of the entire ecosystem

  • Working from one of Brussels newest, nicest and most advanced office spaces

  • A global, collaborative and tech-driven environment.

  • Autonomy & Impact - our flat structure means you can contribute your ideas from day one and help shape the foundation that will power Keyrock’s future business.

  • Culture of Excellence - we value nimbleness, drive for success, owner mentality and collaboration.

  • Opportunity to leave your mark and start your career in one of the most reputable companies in the digital assets world

  • We are envisioning for the internship to be based pre-dominantly in Brussels. It is possible for a selected candidate to be based in London, UK, provided at least 1-2 months onboarding period would be spent in Brussels together with the rest of the interns cohort.

 

Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will own the technical direction of Alpaca's streaming platform - our Redpanda-based event backbone and the user-facing streaming infrastructure. Platform also owns Authentication, Developer Experience and QA, and AI-Native Engineering. Streaming is roughly two-thirds of the job and where we expect you to become the deepest engineer in the company; across the other three you review the designs, hold an informed opinion, and lead the work where they meet streaming.

This is a Staff role, so we are hiring for direction as much as delivery - the engineer who decides what the streaming platform looks like in two years, writes the RFC that gets three teams to agree, and then builds the hard part. We own client-facing and internal services, maintain shared libraries nearly every team depends on, and manage our own deployments. Most of our time goes into Go, but we also write Helm charts, dig through logs and metrics, and get pulled into a wide variety of problems.

Things You Get To Do

  • Own the architecture of our event streaming platform end to end - Redpanda, the UTS ecosystem, client libraries and user-facing streaming - and set its two-to-three-year direction
  • Lead the shift from batch to event-driven across Alpaca's systems, working with the teams who own them rather than around them
  • Design user-facing streaming at scale: connection fan-out, slow consumers, backpressure, ordering and delivery guarantees, and the failure modes that only show up on a volatile market day
  • Set the standards for event-driven design - schema evolution, topic ownership, replay, idempotency - and own the shared libraries other teams build against, including the cost of versioning and deprecation
  • Shape AuthN/AuthZ direction across Alpaca and lead the work where identity meets streaming: authorizing real-time subscriptions, token lifecycle on long-lived connections, multi-tenant isolation
  • Help shape how Alpaca builds with AI - the schemas, contracts and event streams you own are the substrate our agentic development platform runs on
  • Partner with SRE on chaos testing and game days for the event backbone, and with our QA stream on test tooling and pre-production gates, so resilience is verified rather than assumed
  • Lead through influence rather than authority, and multiply the engineers around you through mentoring, design review, and handing off the work that grows people
  • Join the Platform on-call rotation and act as technical lead during incidents affecting shared infrastructure

Who You Are (must-haves)

  • 8+ years of professional engineering experience, including several years running systems at real scale. You write Go, or have deep experience in another strongly-typed language and will pick it up quickly.
  • You have architected event streaming systems, not just used them - real production depth in Kafka or Redpanda across partitioning, consumer groups, rebalancing, retention and delivery guarantees, and how each breaks under load.
  • You have delivered realtime data to clients at scale (WebSockets, SSE or gRPC streaming) and handled fan-out, slow consumers and backpressure in production.
  • You have driven technical direction across team boundaries without formal authority. You can point to the decisions you owned, the RFCs you wrote, and what happened next.
  • You have built or maintained libraries many teams depend on, and know what backward compatibility and deprecation actually cost.
  • You have mentored senior engineers and left the teams around you better than you found them.
  • You have real depth in at least one adjacent area - identity and access, developer tooling and CI, or testing and resilience - and genuine curiosity about the others.
  • You know Kubernetes beyond the basics: you can write a Helm chart with relative ease, you understand security best practices, and you have job experience or certifications to prove it.
  • You have worked with relational databases - we use PostgreSQL, but we are not picky as long as the fundamentals are solid.
  • You have worked at a startup before - you thrive in ambiguous environments, embrace changing priorities, know when to balance technical debt with speed, and proactively tackle whatever needs to get done without relying on pre-existing processes or documentation.

Who You Might Be (nice-to-haves)

  • You’ve worked with an IDL or binary serialization format (Protobuf, Avro; we use FlatBuffers) and handled schema evolution across many consumers.
  • You have experience with change data capture (Debezium, PeerDB or similar) and understand how Postgres logical replication works.
  • You’ve worked on auth systems - OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT lifecycle, Keycloak or Cognito - especially around long-lived connections or machine-to-machine access.
  • You’ve built agentic or AI-native developer tooling, or designed systems meant to be operated by agents rather than only by people.
  • You’ve run chaos engineering or game days, or built the load and fault-injection testing that makes them worth running.
  • You’ve done IaC with Argo CD or Terraform.
  • You have experience with Grafana’s observability stack - Prometheus, Tempo and all the rest. You might have even written a PromQL query for a new alert once or twice.
  • You’ve worked in fintech or another regulated domain and understand how compliance constraints shape architecture.

  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card
